'''Eagle Eye''' is a [[mod]] that increases the zoom of a rifle by 10% per rank up to a maximum of 40% at rank 3. Eagle Eye also increases the range at which [[Sentinels]] or [[MOA (Companion)|MOAs]] can shoot enemies if installed on a [[:Category:Robotic Weapons|Robotic Weapon]].

Eagle Eye is usable in both PvE and [[PvP]].

Certain '''Enemy Body Parts''' will apply damage multipliers to incoming damage that is inflicted on them. These special enemy body parts are specific to each enemy type, and the multipliers are applied to all damage inflicted, independent of their damage type. Targeting these body parts will also completely bypass their [[Shield Gating]]. {{clr}} ==Body Part Types== An internal set of flags for each enemy body part hitbox determines how the game handles the damage it receives, the bonuses that apply, and any effects that result. There are flags for "weak point" and "headshot" (which are distinct, but mostly overlapping categories), and a third category for the [[Critical_Hit#Critical_Headshots|critical headshot bonus]] that is narrower. Each body part also has a built-in damage multiplier, which can be increased by Weak Point Damage bonuses, such as from {{M|Primary Acuity}}, if it is a weak point. Generally, parts flagged as "weak point" and/or "headshot" have a multiplier above 1, and the rest of the body usually¹ has a multiplier of 1 or below. ===Weak Point Hits=== Weak points include organic and robotic heads, but also includes many body parts that are not literally a head (such as {{E|Techrot Skuzzi}}'s speakers, {{E|Rogue Voidrig|Voidrig}}'s back, {{E|Scyto Raknoid}}'s glue sac, among many others) as well as nodes highlighted by {{WF|Banshee}}'s {{A|Sonar}}. When a weak point is hit, the following occurs: *The weak point damage multiplier is applied. **Typical multiplier for headshots against {{Faction|Grineer}}, {{Faction|Corpus}}, {{Faction|Infested}}, {{Faction|Sentient}}, {{Faction|Anarchs}}, {{Faction|Narmer}}, and {{Faction|Orokin|Corrupted}} variants is 3.0x. **For {{Faction|The Murmur}} and {{Faction|Techrot}}, the usual multiplier is closer to 1.5x. *The effects of any "weak point damage" bonuses are applied additively to the weak point multiplier. If the weak point is also a head, then bonuses apply at 1.5x rate. **Ex: a headshot on a weak point with a 3x multiplier, with {{A|Seek}} and a max rank {{M|Primary Acuity}}, has the following multiplier: ***(3 + 1.5 * (3.5 + 0.75)) = 9.375x. **Ex: the above example, but on a non-headshot 1x weak point: ***(1 + 3.5 + 0.75) = 5.25x. *The effects of any "weak point critical chance" bonuses are applied to the shot, additive with bonuses like {{M|Point Strike}}. *Any "on Weak Point hit" or "on Weak Point kill" effects are activated. *Ranged [[Incarnon]] weapons generate charge. ===Headshots=== With a few exceptions², most weak point hits also count as a headshot. Nodes highlighted by {{A|Sonar}} retain their original body/head designation. When a head is hit, the following additionally occurs: *The effects of any "headshot multiplier" bonuses (from sources like {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead|Deadhead}}, {{A|Prowl}}, [[Sniper Rifle|Sniper]] zoom bonuses, etc.) are applied to the damage of the shot. **Ex: the first example given in the weak point section, but with Primary Deadhead and Prowl: ***(3 + 1.5 * (3.5 + 0.75)) * (1 + 0.3 + 0.4) = 15.9375x. *Any "on headshot" or "on headshot kill" effects are activated. For a list of categorized enemy body parts, see [[Enemy_Body_Parts#Special_Body_Part_Multipliers|Special Body Part Multipliers]] below. '''Bodyshots'''
There are no positive bonuses for body hits, although they can receive a damage penalty from {{M|Meticulous Aim}}. '''Non-Body Hits'''
Enemies sometimes have hitboxes that are flagged as neither bodyshot nor headshot locations (no effect from {{M|Meticulous Aim}}), such as the shield of {{E|Symbilyst}}, the canisters of {{E|Aerolyst}}, and growths on the {{E|H-09 Efervon Tank (Techrot)}}. Similar to objects, they cannot be afflicted with a [[Status Effect|status effect]], lack [[armor]], resistances and weaknesses, and can usually be destroyed independently of the main body. However, they are distinct from [[Damage/Object|object health]], since critical damage applies. * Although the {{E|H-09 Efervon Tank (Techrot)|H-09 Efervon Tank}}'s growths activate "on weak point hits" effects and generate Incarnon charge, the damage dealt on hits to them is not increased by Acuity mods. ¹ There are exceptions, for example, {{E|Leaping Thrasher}} has a skull sticking out of its back that takes 3x damage, but is strictly a bodyshot location.
² {{E|The Severed Warden}}'s arms, {{E|Scaldra Harbinger}}'s balloon, and {{E|Amalgam Heqet}}'s backpack are weak points, but not headshots. With Update 44, {{E|Isolator Bursa|Bursa}} units and {{E|MOA}}s (except Anti, Disc and Fusion variants) have had hitboxes on their rear ends changed to non-headshot weak points, and {{E|Lumbering Fragment}}'s weak point has become a non-headshot weak point as well. ==Critical Headshots== The critical headshot, or "headcrit", flag activates the [[Critical_Hit#Critical_Headshots|critical headshot bonus]]. This is applied more narrowly and literally than the headshot flag. As a result, many enemies cannot be headcrit. Although it activates reliably on the heads of {{Faction|Grineer}} (along with {{Faction|Orokin|Corrupted}}/{{Faction|Narmer}}/{{Faction|Anarchs}} variants of Grineer), {{Faction|Anarchs|Dax Anarchs}}, {{Faction|Scaldra}} and most {{Faction|Infested}} and {{Faction|Sentient}} foes, it excludes the heads of all {{Faction|Corpus}} humanoids and ground units, most of the {{Faction|The Murmur}}, and much of {{Faction|Techrot}}. *Applies a 2x multiplier to the weapon's base [[Critical Hit|critical multiplier]] (Critical Damage) **There are some enemies that have a different critical multiplier. For example, the {{E|Juggernaut}}'s maw and belly both have a 4x multiplier, and the {{E|Ropalolyst}}'s head has a 0.2x multiplier. ===Critical Promotion=== Some weak points, like {{E|Rogue Culverin}}'s arm canisters and {{Faction|Scaldra}} backpacks, will increase the [[Critical_Hit#Critical_Tiers|critical tier]] of incoming hits. For example, a non-crit would become a tier 1 yellow crit, a tier 1 yellow crit would become a tier 2 orange crit, and so forth. ==Bonuses to Headshots and Weak Points== ===Weak Point Damage and Critical Chance Bonuses===

*Multishot affects the beam but not the small radial damage effect where the beam ends.
*Punch Through can be slotted but has no effect on the weapon.

==Trivia==
*An [[wikipedia:embolism|embolism]] refers to the lodging of an [[wikipedia:embolus|embolus]], such as a blood clot or gas bubble. It can cause a circulatory blockage which affects a different part of the body away from the actual site of the blockage.
*The visual effect of the Embolist resembles the special attack of the [[Nauseous Crawler]], indicating that this weapon may be a part of said Infested or derived from it. However, apart from the similar attack appearance there are no shared properties.
*The 'tail' on this weapon moves.
*Interestingly, the weapon's reload animation seems to involve pulling (or possibly twisting) the weapon's tail.
*Originally the weapon behaved exactly like the [[Ignis]], having infinite body punch through and having the rare effect of proccing toxin on every hit even if the weapon's toxin was changed to a new element. Both of these mechanics were entirely removed for unknown reasons.

==Known Bugs==

'''Enkaus''' is {{WF|Follie}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] [[Continuous Weapon|beam]] rifle, hosing down its targets with a stream of {{D|Corrosive}} ink. Its [[Alternate Fire]] launches a glob of ink that stains enemies, allowing follow-up primary fire to refund Enkaus ammo and instantly dissolving them when they hit a certain health threshold.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Corrosive}} damage.
*This weapon does not use ammo pickups, instead having infinite reserve ammo.
*[[Alternate Fire]] consumes '''15''' ammo to launch an ink projectile that explodes in an '''8''' meter radius on contact with enemies or a surface. Enemies hit by the blast are covered with ink for '''20''' seconds. The projectile will also leave a puddle with a '''8''' meter radius, lasting for '''10''' seconds and staining enemies that come into contact with it.
**When wielded by {{WF|Follie}}, the [[Alternate Fire]] applies [[Follie/Abilities/Passive|Inkblot]], Follie's passive.
***Enemies afflicted by Inkblot are considered ink-stained targets, even if the Enkaus's alternate fire wasn't used.
**Shooting ink-stained enemies with the primary fire draws ink back into the weapon, causing the Enkaus to consume no ammo and restore '''0.33''' ammo per hit for each enemy hit.
**{{M|Firestorm}} increases the area of the paint left on the ground.
**Ink-stained enemies will be dissolved and instantly killed if Enkaus drops their health below '''35%'''. Enemy health can be lowered by other sources before instakilling them with Enkaus.
***Enemies with special states such as {{E|Thrax Centurion}} or {{E|Kuva Larvling}} will not be dissolved to avoid breaking their mechanics. Bosses cannot be instakilled.
***AoE extra-hit sources (e.g. {{M|Combustion Beam}}, {{D|Blast}} procs) will trigger the instakill.
***When wielded by {{WF|Garuda}}, while the enemy is inflicted with {{A|Seeking Talons}}, the instakill damage element will change from {{D|Corrosive}} to {{D|Slash}}.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
